data.body: **[P1] Recheck scope fatals before `execute()` returns.** This check runs only before end dispatch. If a timed-out scope reports `VirtualMachineError` or `ThreadDeath` while an end hook is blocked or during `ExecutionManager.close()`, the caller still returns `PENDING` or rethrows the retry outcome even though the fatal was observed before the Lambda response was produced. Preserve the selected outcome through end dispatch and manager closure, then call `throwIfScopeFatal` immediately before returning or rethrowing it; update the late-dispatch regression to require caller propagation.
